objective: Prioritize high-concurrency throughput while preserving quality; report TTFA p50/p95 and mean RTF

metrics.ttfa: first unique audio sample receipt minus dispatch
metrics.rtf_mean: mean((last unique audio sample receipt minus dispatch) / audio_duration)

limitations: Steady-state repeats do not reset server caches and are not the peer engine cold-cache certification.
SGLang emits a terminal waveform; vLLM uses streamed chunks, so TTFA semantics differ.
Initial local-checkpoint scan excluded because config/custom code differed from official metadata.
